# xyzs996

> Index of xyzs996's open source projects. Each description below is the repository's own, unedited.

## Projects

- [llm-api-pricing](https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/): Coding agent pricing comparison: cheapest LLM API for coding, cost per million tokens, from the OpenRouter price list as JSON and CSV. An AI model token price comparison repriced at a real agent mix — 95.6% cached input pricing, 6.5x off list: prompt caching price, cache read price, cache hit share, long context pricing, DeepSeek peak/off-peak.
- [free-llm-api](https://xyzs996.github.io/free-llm-api/): Free LLM API providers list: verified free tier limits, API keys with no credit card, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints for developers.
- [free-proxy-health-list](https://xyzs996.github.io/free-proxy-health-list/): Free proxy list by country: verified SOCKS5, SOCKS4, HTTP and HTTPS proxies, rechecked every 30 minutes, as TXT, JSON and CSV.
- [iptv-doctor](https://xyzs996.github.io/iptv-doctor/): IPTV playlist checker: an IPTV checker tool that removes dead M3U/M3U8 streams, fixes XMLTV EPG, and tracks live stream status.

## Data

- [The figures table](https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/figures.html): every figure quoted in the field notes as a readable page — one row each, and each row carries the full sentence it was published in.
- [figures.json](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/xyzs996/llm-api-pricing@main/data/figures.json): The same rows as JSON, with the columns value, kind, unit, context, article, published, url, medium, thread.
- [figures.csv](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/xyzs996/llm-api-pricing@main/data/figures.csv): The same rows as CSV.

What a row looks like — the per-million-token prices, each with the sentence it was published in:

- $0.06 / $0.2 per million: "At the low end, MiniMax M3 runs $0.06 to $0.2 per million and draws 60% to 70% of its revenue from outside its home market." — https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/articles/1-6-billion-free-tokens-is-a-compression-ratio-not-a.html
- $0.19 / $5 per million tokens: "The competition among model vendors used to be argued in benchmark scores, and it is now being argued in cost per million tokens — Indian enterprises are adopting Chinese models at input prices as low as $0.19 per million tokens against $5 to $12 for comparable American offerings, which is not a discount so much as a different category of product." — https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/articles/the-token-cost-war-why-price-per-million-tokens-now-decides.html
- $0.81 / $2.00 per million input tokens: "Line up 40 models by the price on the card and the Chinese ones look like a rout: the median lists at $0.81 per million input tokens against $2.00 for the American ones, a gap of 2.47x." — https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/articles/chinese-models-are-not-2x-cheaper-once-your-agent-starts.html
- $1 per million tokens: "Top-tier Chinese models such as GLM5.2 and DeepSeek V4 Pro sit near $1 per million tokens at inference gross margins of 10% to 20%." — https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/articles/1-6-billion-free-tokens-is-a-compression-ratio-not-a.html
- $1.25 / $4.25 per million: "Meta priced Muse Spark 1.1 at $1.25 per million input and $4.25 per million output, roughly 75% and 83% below Anthropic's Opus, and the tradeoff is visible in the benchmarks, since it leads on MCP Atlas and JobBench while trailing on SWE-Bench Pro and DeepSWE 1.1." — https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/articles/1-6-billion-free-tokens-is-a-compression-ratio-not-a.html
- $1.25 per million input tokens: "Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 agent model API is priced at $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens — roughly 75% and 83% below Anthropic Opus on input and output respectively — and the target is explicit: become the cheap entry point for agent workflows and pull developers into the ecosystem." — https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/articles/the-token-cost-war-why-price-per-million-tokens-now-decides.html
- $1.475 per million: "Qwen3.7 Max lists at $1.475 per million input." — https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/articles/chinese-models-are-not-2x-cheaper-once-your-agent-starts.html
- $3 per million input tokens: "The $3 per million input tokens price point means developers should carefully evaluate whether the premium model's capabilities justify the increased costs for their specific use cases." — https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/articles/choosing-the-right-ai-model-for-coding-cost-vs-efficiency.html
- $4.25 per million output tokens: "Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 agent model API is priced at $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens — roughly 75% and 83% below Anthropic Opus on input and output respectively — and the target is explicit: become the cheap entry point for agent workflows and pull developers into the ecosystem." — https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/articles/the-token-cost-war-why-price-per-million-tokens-now-decides.html
- $50 per million: "Output — the scariest sticker, $25 or $50 per million — is under a third of one percent of the volume." — https://xyzs996.github.io/llm-api-pricing/articles/chinese-models-are-not-2x-cheaper-once-your-agent-starts.html
